Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_CAMPAIGN_ID
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** retrieve data
*/
declare
 h_alert_response number;
 id_alert ALERT;

 nCount number;

/* LOV */
 h_lov_rtn_value boolean;
 h_lov_id LOV;

 cursor cur_campaign is
 select campaign_id, campaign_short_name
 from campaigns
 where campaign_id like :ctrl_block.campaign_id || '%'
 or campaign_short_name like :ctrl_block.campaign_id || '%';

 cursor cur_campaign_eff is
 select campaign_id, campaign_short_name
 from campaigns
 where ( campaign_id like :ctrl_block.campaign_id || '%'
 or campaign_short_name like :ctrl_block.campaign_id || '%') 
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) >= trunc( SYSDATE );

begin
 if :ctrl_block.campaign_id is null then
 show_error ('11033');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.campaign_id = 'NEW' then
/* To create a NEW Campaign */
 id_alert := find_alert('new_campaign_alert');
 if id_null(id_alert) then
 show_error ('9203');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :global.new_campaign := 'Y';
 :global.new_asked := 'TRUE';
 h_alert_response := show_alert(id_alert);
 if h_alert_response = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
-- show_error('11017');
-- :global.new_campaign := 'N';
-- execute_trigger( 'key-clrfrm' );
 :ctrl_block.campaign_id := null;
 :global.new_campaign := 'N';
 :global.new_asked := 'FALSE';
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 :global.new_campaign := 'Y';
 end if;
 else
/* Retrieval process */
/* Get appropriate count */
 if :ctrl_block.show_term = 'Y' then
 select count(*)
 into nCount 
 from campaigns
 where campaign_id like :ctrl_block.campaign_id || '%'
 or campaign_short_name like :ctrl_block.campaign_id || '%';
 else
 select count(*)
 into nCount 
 from campaigns
 where ( campaign_id like :ctrl_block.campaign_id || '%'
 or campaign_short_name like :ctrl_block.campaign_id || '%') 
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) >= trunc( SYSDATE );
 end if;
 if nCount > 1 then
/* More than one record found - Show LOV */
 if :ctrl_block.show_term = 'Y' then
 set_item_property( 'ctrl_block.campaign_id', lov_name, 'campaign_id_lov');
 h_lov_id := find_lov('campaign_id_lov');
 else
 set_item_property( 'ctrl_block.campaign_id', lov_name, 'eff_camp_id_lov');
 h_lov_id := find_lov('eff_camp_id_lov');
 end if;

 if id_null(h_lov_id) then
 message ('11008');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 h_lov_rtn_value := show_lov(h_lov_id);

 if h_lov_rtn_value = FALSE then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
-- list_values( restrict );
 elsif nCount = 0 then
/* No record found - Show Error */
 show_error ('11038');
 check_package_failure;
 else
/* One record found - Show Details */
 if :ctrl_block.show_term = 'Y' then
 open cur_campaign;
 fetch cur_campaign into :ctrl_block.campaign_id,
 :ctrl_block.campaign_short_name;

 if cur_campaign%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_campaign;
 show_error ('11038');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 close cur_campaign;
 Set_Block_Property('campaigns',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE); 
 Set_Block_Property('campaigns',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE); 
 Set_Block_Property('campaigns',DEFAULT_WHERE,'campaign_id = :ctrl_block.campaign_id'); 
/*
 go_block('campaigns');
 execute_query;
*/
 end if;
 else
 open cur_campaign_eff;
 fetch cur_campaign_eff into :ctrl_block.campaign_id,
 :ctrl_block.campaign_short_name;

 if cur_campaign_eff%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_campaign;
 show_error ('11038');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 close cur_campaign_eff;
 Set_Block_Property('campaigns',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE); 
 Set_Block_Property('campaigns',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE); 
 Set_Block_Property('campaigns',DEFAULT_WHERE,'campaign_id = :ctrl_block.campaign_id'); 
/*
 go_block('campaigns');
 execute_query;
*/
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** validate eff date
** 1. should not be null
** 2. should be a valid date
** 3. should be later than system date
*/
declare
 v_local_time DATE;
begin
 
 -- Converts GMT date to local date (IM# 5320)
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 --

 if :campaigns.eff_date is null then
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
-- show_error('11012');
 --elsif :campaigns.eff_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 elsif :campaigns.eff_date < trunc(v_local_time) then
 show_error('12011');
 check_package_failure;
-- show_error('11014');
 end if;

 if :campaigns.term_date is not null then
 if :campaigns.eff_date > trunc(:campaigns.term_date) then
 show_error('11013');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if; 

exception
 when value_error then
 show_error('0022');
 check_package_failure;
-- show_error('9191');

end;

Trigger.Name: ON-CHECK-DELETE-MASTER
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 Dummy_Define VARCHAR2(1);
 --
 -- Begin CENTRAL_NOTES detail declare section
 --
 CURSOR CENTRAL_NOTES_cur IS 
 SELECT 1 FROM CENTRAL_NOTES 
 WHERE NOTE_ID = :CAMPAIGNS.NOTE_ID;
 --
 -- End CENTRAL_NOTES detail declare section
 --
 --
 -- Begin CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS detail declare section
 --
 CURSOR CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS_cur IS 
 SELECT 1 FROM CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS 
 WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID = :CAMPAIGNS.CAMPAIGN_ID;
 --
 -- End CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS detail declare section
 --
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 --
 -- Begin CENTRAL_NOTES detail program section
 --
 OPEN CENTRAL_NOTES_cur; 
 FETCH CENTRAL_NOTES_cur INTO Dummy_Define; 
 IF ( CENTRAL_NOTES_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE CENTRAL_NOTES_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE CENTRAL_NOTES_cur;
 --
 -- End CENTRAL_NOTES detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS detail program section
 --
 OPEN CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS_cur; 
 FETCH CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS_cur INTO Dummy_Define; 
 IF ( CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS_cur%found ) THEN 
 Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.'); 
 CLOSE CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS_cur; 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;
 CLOSE CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS_cur;
 --
 -- End CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS detail program section
 --
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
 recstat VARCHAR2(20) := :System.record_status; 
 startitm VARCHAR2(61) := :System.cursor_item; 
 rel_id Relation;
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
 IF ( recstat = 'NEW' or recstat = 'INSERT' ) THEN 
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 --
 -- Begin CENTRAL_NOTES detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:CAMPAIGNS.NOTE_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('CAMPAIGNS.CAMP_NOTES');
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'CENTRAL_NOTES');
 last_record;
 END IF;
 --
 -- End CENTRAL_NOTES detail program section
 --
 --
 -- Begin CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS detail program section
 --
 IF ( (:CAMPAIGNS.CAMPAIGN_ID is not null) ) THEN 
 rel_id := Find_Relation('CAMPAIGNS.CAMP_MEDIA');
 Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS');
 END IF;
 --
 -- End CAMPAIGN_MEDIAS detail program section
 --

 IF ( :System.cursor_item <> startitm ) THEN 
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

PROCEDURE CHECK_NOTES IS
 bValidFound boolean := FALSE;
 bCleared boolean := FALSE;
BEGIN
 go_block('central_notes');
 last_record;
 loop
-- message(:system.cursor_record || ', ' || :system.record_status );
 bCleared := FALSE;
 if :central_notes.note is null then
 if bValidFound = TRUE then
 show_error( '11034' );
 message( 'Err - Note cannot be null' ); pause;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 clear_record;
 bCleared := TRUE;
 if :system.cursor_record = '1' then
-- If first note record is null, then the note_id should not be stored
 :campaigns.note_id := null;
 end if;
 end if;
 else
 bValidFound := TRUE;
-- message( 'Valid Found' ); pause;
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_record = '1' then
 exit;
 else
 if bCleared = FALSE then
 previous_record;
 end if;
 end if;
 end loop;
END;
